# Grok Bot skills

> Free Grok Bot and AI agent SKILL.md templates with standing safety rules, plus paid skill packs for a multi-bot fleet, reminders, a credit coach, and a project sprint.

A skill is an instruction file a Grok Bot or similar AI assistant follows. The free skills in https://github.com/skillsforbots/grok-bot-skills are MIT-licensed. Paid packs are sold separately on Gumroad under their own terms.

## Skills for any AI bot

- [What are agent skills? A plain-English guide for bot owners](https://skillsforbots.com/agent-skills/): What a SKILL.md skill is, what's inside one, how bots load skills, how skills differ from prompts, routines, MCP and AGENTS.md, which tools read them, and a five-step safety check before installing one.
- [SKILL.md template you can copy](https://skillsforbots.com/skill-md/template/): An annotated SKILL.md template with frontmatter name and description, when to use it, steps, output format, an ask-before-acting section, and a disclaimer, plus a filled-in example and a compatibility table by kind of tool.
- [Free SKILL.md checker](https://skillsforbots.com/tools/skill-md-checker/): Paste a SKILL.md to check frontmatter, name and description rules, length, a safety or approval section, a disclaimer, risky actions (send, spend, delete, payments, passwords, API keys), hidden text, remote code, and links. Runs in the browser; nothing is uploaded. A helper, not a guarantee.

## Free skills

- [Bot Safety Rules Starter](https://github.com/skillsforbots/grok-bot-skills/blob/main/skills/bot-safety-rules-starter/SKILL.md): Standing rules that no bot sends email or messages without owner approval, no bot spends money, and a one-time approval is not a standing waiver, plus a blank structured handoff note.
- Also on Agensi: [Bot Safety Rules Starter](https://www.agensi.io/skills/bot-safety-rules-starter)
- [Reminder Basics](https://github.com/skillsforbots/grok-bot-skills/blob/main/skills/reminder-basics/SKILL.md): One reminder that repeats daily until the owner clearly says it is done. Free, limited version of Nag-Until-Cleared Reminders (one item, one daily time).
- Also on Agensi: [Reminder Basics](https://www.agensi.io/skills/reminder-basics)
- [Usage Reset Sprint](https://github.com/skillsforbots/grok-bot-skills/blob/main/skills/usage-reset-sprint/SKILL.md): Use leftover usage on a project right before a usage or token limit resets: check remaining usage and the reset time, finish the highest-value chunk that fits, and leave a handoff so work can resume after the reset. Does not buy credits or spend money to get more usage. Free, limited version of Project Sprint (one window, one handoff).
- Also on Agensi: [Usage Reset Sprint](https://www.agensi.io/skills/usage-reset-sprint)

## Premium packs

- [Bot Fleet Coordinator](https://skillsforbots.gumroad.com/l/ergple): $12. A primary bot that routes each task to the right specialist, writes a handoff note, and follows no-send / no-spend rules.
- Also on Agensi: [Bot Fleet Coordinator](https://www.agensi.io/skills/bot-fleet-coordinator)
- [Nag-Until-Cleared Reminders](https://skillsforbots.gumroad.com/l/hdqoqb): $9. Reminders that keep coming back until you clearly say an item is done.
- Also on Agensi: [Nag-Until-Cleared Reminders](https://www.agensi.io/skills/nag-until-cleared-reminders)
- [Credit Repair Coach](https://skillsforbots.gumroad.com/l/ifujn): $12. Educational daily or on-demand credit briefs with today's top 3 actions, labeled estimates, and letter drafts you send yourself. Not financial or legal advice; no results promised.
- Also on Agensi: [Credit Repair Coach](https://www.agensi.io/skills/credit-repair-coach)
- [Project Sprint](https://skillsforbots.gumroad.com/l/project-sprint): $19. Plan a project across several usage windows, finish a high-value chunk before each reset, and pick up from a handoff after, without buying more credits.
- Also on Agensi: [Project Sprint](https://www.agensi.io/skills/project-sprint)
- [Bot Owner Starter Bundle](https://skillsforbots.gumroad.com/l/vxecie): $19. The Bot Fleet Coordinator, Nag-Until-Cleared Reminders, and Credit Repair Coach in one download (saves $14 vs $33 separately).
- Also on Agensi: [Bot Owner Starter Bundle](https://www.agensi.io/bundles/bot-owner-starter-bundle)

## Guides

- [All guides](https://skillsforbots.com/guides/): Every guide on the site, grouped by install, safety, routines, and comparisons.

- [How to stop your AI bot from spending money](https://skillsforbots.com/how-to-stop-ai-bot-spending-money/): Platform limits, keeping payment details away from bots, a standing no-spend rule, and hidden costs like trials that bill later.
- [How to make AI bot reminders that don't stop until you're done](https://skillsforbots.com/ai-bot-reminders-that-dont-stop/): Defining what counts as done, a two-line reminder message, and a daily routine setup.
- [How to coordinate multiple AI bots](https://skillsforbots.com/coordinate-multiple-ai-bots/): One lane per bot, a single coordinator, a written handoff note, shared safety rules, and a weekly read-only review.
- [How to make your AI bot ask before it acts](https://skillsforbots.com/ai-bot-ask-before-acting/): A standing approval rule for sending, posting, or spending, with one-time yes staying one-time, plus a test and platform settings.
- [How to get a daily credit action plan from an AI bot](https://skillsforbots.com/ai-bot-daily-credit-action-plan/): A short daily or on-demand brief with today's top 3 actions, figures labeled as estimates, and letter drafts you send yourself. Educational only; not financial or legal advice; no results promised.
- [How to add a skill to your AI bot](https://skillsforbots.com/how-to-add-a-skill-to-your-ai-bot/): What a SKILL.md file is, how to fill placeholders and add it as standing instructions, and how to test that it loaded.
- [How to make your AI bot use its remaining usage before the limit resets](https://skillsforbots.com/ai-bot-use-remaining-usage-before-reset/): Check remaining usage and the reset time, finish the highest-value chunk that fits, leave a handoff, and resume after reset, without buying more credits.

## Install a skill

- [How to Add a Skill to Any AI Bot](https://skillsforbots.com/install/): How to install an agent skill in any AI bot: five steps that work everywhere, and where Grok Bot, Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, and Cursor take skills.
- [How to Install Grok Bot Skills From GitHub (3 Ways)](https://skillsforbots.com/install/grok-bot/): Three ways to install a Grok Bot skill from GitHub: paste the SKILL.md, give the bot the repo link, or copy the folder. Plus how to check it loaded.
- [How to Add a Skill to Claude and Claude Code](https://skillsforbots.com/install/claude/): Add a custom skill to Claude: upload a ZIP in Customize, Skills on claude.ai, or put a SKILL.md folder in ~/.claude/skills for Claude Code. Plus fixes.
- [ChatGPT Skills: How to Add One, With Everyday Examples](https://skillsforbots.com/install/chatgpt/): How to add a skill in ChatGPT: create with chat, the editor, or an upload. Who has access, how the scan works, using @, and four everyday skill ideas.
- [Codex Skills Location: Where to Put SKILL.md](https://skillsforbots.com/install/codex/): Where Codex looks for skills: .agents/skills up to the repo root, $HOME/.agents/skills, /etc/codex/skills, and built-ins. How to add, use, and disable one.
- [Cursor Skills Folder: Where Skills Go and How to Add One](https://skillsforbots.com/install/cursor/): Where Cursor looks for skills (.cursor/skills, .agents/skills, and your home folder), how to add a SKILL.md, invoke it, and sync it to Cloud Agents.
- [Which AI Bots Read SKILL.md (and Where Each One Looks)](https://skillsforbots.com/skill-md/which-bots-support-it/): Which AI tools read SKILL.md skills and the folder each checks: Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, OpenClaw, Grok Bot, more.

## Safety and approvals

- [How to Check an AI Skill Is Safe Before You Install It](https://skillsforbots.com/safety/check-a-skill-before-installing/): An 8-step check before you install an agent skill in Grok Bot, Claude, ChatGPT, or any AI bot: risky actions, hidden text, scripts, and a safe test.
- [Approval Rules for AI Bots: A No-Send, No-Spend Template](https://skillsforbots.com/safety/approval-rules/): A copy-paste approval rules template for AI bots and agents: what needs a yes, what the bot must show you, what counts as approval, and how to test it.

## Compare

- [SKILL.md vs AGENTS.md vs CLAUDE.md: Which File Does What](https://skillsforbots.com/compare/skill-md-vs-agents-md/): SKILL.md, AGENTS.md, and CLAUDE.md all hold instructions for AI agents, but they load at different times and do different jobs. When to use each.
- [Agent Skills vs MCP Servers: What Each One Does](https://skillsforbots.com/compare/skills-vs-mcp/): Agent skills teach an AI bot how to do a job. MCP servers connect it to tools and data. A plain comparison, when you need each, and how they work together.
- [Skills vs Scheduled Tasks (Routines): The How and the When](https://skillsforbots.com/routines/skills-vs-scheduled-tasks/): A skill tells an AI bot how to do a job. A routine or scheduled task tells it when. How they differ in Grok Bot, ChatGPT, and Claude, with two worked examples.

## Roundups

- [Grok Bot Skills on GitHub: The Free Repos Worth Knowing](https://skillsforbots.com/skills/grok-bot-skills-github/): An honest list of free Grok Bot skill repos on GitHub: what each one is for, how it installs, and its license, read from each repo on Nov 23, 2026.
- [Best Agent Skills for Everyday Life Admin (Free and Paid)](https://skillsforbots.com/skills/everyday/): Agent skills for everyday life admin, not code: safety rules, reminders, daily plans, usage resets, and shopping decisions. Free and paid, mine and others’.
